marketLayer.title: US Big Tech & Macro Liquidity
marketLayer.fact: U.S. megacap tech equities edged higher ahead of key inflation data and quarterly earnings, with major AI infrastructure leaders raising capex guidance while U.S. Treasury yields stabilized.
marketLayer.inference: Resilient enterprise technology spending continues to absorb macroeconomic tightness, supporting valuation multiples for mega-cap software and hardware firms.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Federal Reserve monetary policy trajectory and potential margin compression if AI monetisation timelines lag aggressive infrastructure spending.

marketLayer.title: Hong Kong Internet & AI Monetization
marketLayer.fact: Hang Seng Tech Index gained traction led by platform giants expanding share buyback programs and detailing growth in enterprise cloud and generative AI revenues.
marketLayer.inference: Aggressive capital return initiatives paired with corporate cost discipline are enhancing free cash flow yield metrics across major HK-listed technology operators.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Sustained momentum in Mainland domestic consumption and potential regulatory updates regarding cross-border data transfer rules.

marketLayer.title: Global Semiconductor Supply Chain
marketLayer.fact: Leading semiconductor packaging and foundry operators reported near-full capacity utilization driven by sustained high-performance computing (HPC) demand.
marketLayer.inference: Upstream hardware suppliers retain strong pricing power, indicating robust near-term capital expenditure commitment from tier-1 cloud service providers.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Geopolitical trade restrictions and potential bottleneck risk in advanced packaging supply chains.

marketLayer.title: HK High-Dividend & State-Owned Enterprises
marketLayer.fact: Mainland telecom operators and state-owned financial institutions listed in Hong Kong saw persistent net buying from Mainland funds via Southbound Stock Connect.
marketLayer.inference: Onshore institutional capital continues to prioritize high-dividend defensive equities to secure cash yield amidst low domestic interest rates.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Variations in HIBOR dynamics and prospective margin compression for regional state-backed financial assets.
